imposter.name: Who's the Imposter?
imposter.description: One secret word. One liar. Find them.

howToPlay.intro: One player is secretly the Imposter — they don't know the secret word. Can the crew sniff them out?
howToPlay.step1_desc: Pass the phone around. Each player taps their name to secretly see the word — or discover they're the Imposter.
howToPlay.step2_desc: Take turns giving one clue about the secret word. The Imposter must bluff. Listen carefully for vague or wrong clues!
howToPlay.step3_desc: After all clues, vote for who you think the Imposter is. Catch them to win — but beware, they can still guess the word to escape!

truth_dare.name: Truth or Dare
truth_dare.description: Answer honestly or face a dare.

howToPlay.intro: Answer an honest question or complete a bold challenge. Will you tell the truth — or take the dare?
howToPlay.step1_desc: On your turn, choose Truth (answer a question honestly) or Dare (complete a physical or social challenge).
howToPlay.step2_desc: The app shows a random truth question or dare challenge. No skipping — you must commit!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Hand the phone to the next player when done. Keep playing as long as you want!

nhie.name: Never Have I Ever
nhie.description: Find out what your friends have done.

howToPlay.intro: Find out what your friends have really done. The more embarrassing the confessions, the better!
howToPlay.step1_desc: Everyone holds up 5 fingers. You'll be putting them down one by one.
howToPlay.step2_desc: The app shows a 'Never Have I Ever...' statement. If you HAVE done it, put a finger down and confess!
howToPlay.step3_desc: The player who loses all fingers first loses the round — and must share their wildest story!

mlt.name: Most Likely To
mlt.description: Who in the group is most likely to...?

howToPlay.intro: Find out what your friends really think about you. Brace yourself!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The app shows a 'Most Likely To...' question, like 'Most likely to become famous.'
howToPlay.step2_desc: On the count of 3, everyone points at the person they think is most likely. No hesitating!
howToPlay.step3_desc: The person with the most fingers pointed at them wins (or loses?) the round. They can respond before the next question!

hot_takes.name: Hot Takes
hot_takes.description: Agree or disagree — debate it out.

howToPlay.intro: Share your boldest opinions and spark a debate. No neutral ground allowed!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The app reveals a controversial statement or opinion for the group to react to.
howToPlay.step2_desc: Each player declares whether they strongly agree or disagree — and must defend their position!
howToPlay.step3_desc: After the debate, vote for the best argument. The most convincing player wins the round!

wyr.name: Would You Rather
wyr.description: Two impossible choices. Which would you pick?

howToPlay.intro: Two equally terrible (or amazing) choices. There's no right answer — only your answer.
howToPlay.step1_desc: The app shows a 'Would You Rather...' question with two options. Think carefully!
howToPlay.step2_desc: Each player picks their option without revealing it. Hold your choice close!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Everyone reveals at once. Discuss your choices and argue your case — majority wins bragging rights!

two_truths.name: Two Truths One Lie
two_truths.description: Guess which statement is the lie.

howToPlay.intro: Share two true things and one convincing lie about yourself. Can your friends tell the difference?
howToPlay.step1_desc: Type two things that are true about yourself and one believable lie into the app.
howToPlay.step2_desc: Read all three statements to the group in any order. Keep a straight face!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Players vote for which statement is the lie. Score a point for every person you fool!

heads_up.name: Heads Up!
heads_up.description: Hold the phone on your forehead. Get clues!

howToPlay.intro: Hold the phone to your forehead and guess the word on the screen — only your friends can see it!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The active player holds the phone face-out on their forehead without peeking at the screen.
howToPlay.step2_desc: All other players shout clues to help guess the word. No spelling it out or saying the word itself!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Tilt the phone down to skip a word, tilt up to confirm a correct guess. Score as many as you can before time runs out!

word_chain.name: Word Chain
word_chain.description: Last letter starts the next word. Don't break the chain!

howToPlay.intro: Every word must start with the last letter of the previous one. Hesitate and you're eliminated!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The first player says any word. The next player must say a word starting with its last letter.
howToPlay.step2_desc: You have a time limit to respond. No repeating words that have already been used in this round.
howToPlay.step3_desc: Hesitate too long, say an invalid word, or repeat a word — and you're out! Last player left wins.

trivia.name: Trivia Bet
trivia.description: Bet on your answer. More confidence = more points.

howToPlay.intro: Answer trivia questions and bet your points based on how confident you are. High risk, high reward!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The app shows a trivia question for the current player. Think before you answer!
howToPlay.step2_desc: Before answering, bet your points. Low bet = safe play. High bet = big risk, big reward!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Correct answer earns your bet. Wrong answer loses it. The player with the most points at the end wins!

charades.name: Charades
charades.description: Act it out — no words allowed!

howToPlay.intro: Act out the secret word using only gestures and expressions. No speaking, no sounds — pure mime!
howToPlay.step1_desc: The acting player secretly sees the word on the phone. Don't show anyone — keep a poker face!
howToPlay.step2_desc: Use gestures, expressions, and body language only. No words, no mouthing, no sounds!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Other players guess aloud. Score a point when they get it right, then the next player takes their turn!

howToPlay.intro: Someone whispers a question. Someone points in secret. Will the answer ever be revealed?
howToPlay.step1_desc: One player whispers a 'Who in this group...' question to the player on their right.
howToPlay.step2_desc: That player silently points at whoever they think fits the answer — no explaining!
howToPlay.step3_desc: Flip a coin — heads reveals the question to everyone, tails keeps it secret forever. The paranoia builds!
